registered_predictions.ladder_rungs_1_2: the exact fold and the materialized tables pass their identity gates at EVERY width and depth in the grid; if a rung fails it fails at the LARGEST width first
registered_predictions.width_effect: held CE improves monotonically with width at fixed depth, with diminishing returns by width 128
registered_predictions.depth_effect: depth 2 beats depth 1 at every width, and the depth-2 gain GROWS with width (composition needs capacity to be worth having)
registered_predictions.baseline_gap: every trained cell beats the closed-form bigram table; the width-32 depth-1 cell beats it by less than 0.5 nats
registered_predictions.attn_table_rank: each layer-0 V x V score table has numerical rank equal to its algebraic bound (head_dim = 16) at delta = 0, so no head wastes its key subspace
registered_predictions.seed_convergence: held CE across seeds at a fixed cell spreads by less than 0.02 nats, but the materialized tables do NOT match across seeds beyond a permutation
